csv_project_name: AE for Portage Lakes State Park Boathouse
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR), through the Divisions of Parks and Watercraft, is responsible for the management of various specialized facilities located at properties across the State. This Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is being issued to procure Professional Design (A/E) services for the replacement of an existing boathouse located within Portage Lakes State Park. The current facility is functionally outdated and no longer meets the operational, structural, or accessibility requirements necessary to support modern law enforcement activities on the park s waterways.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Geotechnical Engineering, Analytical/Testing Services, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Hazardous Waste Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics
